brief.text: You're the recruiter at **Carelink**, hiring a **Operations Lead** to run a 25-person patient support operation. The role has been open 50 days. Budget: **₹15L–₹19L** a year.

The hiring manager's must-haves: "5+ years, from a top brand, MBA preferred, can join in 30 days." Market data for people with 5+ years in this role: median ₹26L; notice periods for employed people are usually 60–90 days.

brief.caption: Profiles in your pipeline
rows: Senior Analyst, Sales Operations at Zentrix Global (a household-name tech company)
Internal reporting role; no customer-facing work
Senior Operations Lead at a listed software company
Operations Lead at a growth-stage startup
Four jobs in five years; two companies shut down. Clear results in each role
MBA from a top business school; no hands-on experience in this work
Operations Lead at a mid-size software company
Improved service levels by 6 points across 35 accounts
Operations Lead (5 years), then a one-year career break to care for a parent
Led the service levels programme before the break; did a refresher course
Operations Lead (2.5 years), before that a school teacher (4 years)
Top of the team on service levels last year
120% of quota; has never managed existing customers

brief.text: The company and numbers are fictional, and every candidate gets a slightly different version. A calculator is fine.

material.text:
Hi Dear Nikhil,

Greetings from Carelink! We are a fast-growing, award-winning company with a great culture and amazing people. We have an urgent opening for Operations Lead. Please send your updated CV along with current CTC, expected CTC and notice period at the earliest.

Best salary in the industry!

Regards

prompt.text: Use any AI tool you like for this one. We are assessing how you use it, not whether you do.
Write the job advert for the Operations Lead (under 250 words), using the must-haves you agreed are really needed for the work.

items: Paste your full AI conversation, or write "none".
In 2–3 lines, say what you kept, changed or rejected from the AI and why.

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

prompt.text: **Tell us about a hard-to-fill role you worked on, and what you did.** What did you see, what did you do, and what would you do differently?
Specifics such as numbers and timelines matter more than polish.
